description:
Port 5 UI/rendering/provider extensions:
- message-renderer.ts → MessageRenderer: registerMessageRenderer for custom entry types
- custom-header.ts → CustomHeader: UI widget registration in header zone
- custom-footer.ts → CustomFooter: UI widget registration in footer zone  
- status-line.ts → StatusLine: status widget updates
- provider-payload.ts → ProviderPayload: provider registration, model config

Exercises UIContext, message renderer registration, and provider config. Heaviest overlap with TUI layer — may surface UIContext gaps.
title: Example extensions wave 4: UI, rendering & providers (message-renderer, custom-header, custom-footer, status-line, provider-payload)
